system.description:
Temporarily nullify Attributes based on their source (e.g., magic, tech). Requires touch and a successful attack action.

  • Level 1: Nullify 1 Level of an Attribute
  • Level 2: Nullify 2 Levels
  • Level 3: Nullify 3 Levels
  • Level 4: Nullify 4 Levels
  • Level 5: Nullify 5 Levels
  • Level 6: Nullify 6 Levels
